​
Gapan Christmas Open 2026 is a World Cube Association (WCA)-sanctioned speedcubing competition to be held at Gapan City, Nueva Ecija, this December. The competition welcomes speedcubers of different ages and skill levels to participate in official WCA events, challenge themselves, and enjoy a day of sportsmanship and community.

We look forward to welcoming everyone for an exciting celebration of speedcubing this Christmas season!

Hosted by the [Central Luzon Cubers](https://www.facebook.com/centralluzoncubers) in partnership with [Robinsons Place Gapan](https://www.facebook.com/robinsonsgapan).
